continuous_interval: 10000 bootstrap resamples of trial means; seed 6216
paired_difference_interval: Conservative 95% difference bound from Bonferroni-adjusted exact binomial marginal intervals; paired discordances and exact McNemar p also reported
failure_selection: Up to six original trajectories: first failed seed per task/method, none before disturbance, task order as listed; first two full-method task failures and first four baseline task failures. All remaining failures retain logs and states. No rerun footage.
interpretation: Named module ablations, not competitive external algorithms; no guarantee that the full method wins. Ten trials give wide uncertainty.
